header: The log of answer attempts (server only; nothing is written unless ANSWER_LOG_FILE is set, e.g. ANSWER_LOG_FILE=reread-reports/answers.jsonl in .env.local; that folder is ignored by Git). It holds one JSON line per attempt: the question, the verdict, the model's own reply and the exact passages the model was shown. `scripts/answer-replay.ts` re-runs the whole file through the CURRENT rules with no model call, so I can understand, fix and prove a refusal from the file instead of going one query at a time.
